thread:
Dana (AM): Kicking off Crestline POC. Needs SAML SSO, SCIM bulk (~500k users) with group->role mapping, domain verification for two domains, and an on-prem air-gapped prod option. They want blockers + pricing bands by Fri.
Maya (SE): Quick Q: do they need sub-hourly deltas or is hourly acceptable? Also what's the acceptable cutover window for the initial import?
Eric (Eng): Hourly deltas are standard. If they need immediate enforcement use SAML attribute assertions and short session TTLs. For bulk import: recommend chunk size 2k-5k, concurrency 8-12, exponential backoff on 429/503 with jitter. Example bulk POST:
```bash
curl -X POST https://scim.redwood.example.com/v2/Bulk -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @bulk.json
```
Sam (Infra): For air-gapped: we require network diagram, host inventory, RTO/RPO, storage encryption details, and a signed SOW for zero control-plane access. Air-gap support adds ~15% uplift + one-time deployment fee.
Maya (SE): RBAC approach: SCIM groups->roles for initial bootstrap and periodic sync; SAML assertions for runtime enforcement. We can enable webhooks for near-real-time but call out scale/backpressure caveats.
sec-bot: sec-bot: SOC2 artefacts and sec pack link sent -> https://redwood.example.com/sec/crestline
Dana (AM): Action items: (1) Dana collect network diagram, SAML metadata, domain TXT proof requirements; (2) Eric produce SCIM import runbook + backoff params + sample configs; (3) Maya draft pricing (Dedicated reserved sizing + Hosted-fallback + air-gap uplift); (4) Sam produce KMS/HSM checklist for Legal. Sync Thu EOD. :thumbsup:
